rev.t: We recently had our Babyshower ceremony photography done with Manjunath Studio and the pictures have come out great. They made sure all our moments are captured. This was our second time engaging them in our function and definitely not the last. Keep up the good work!
Very good photo services for a very reasonable price!

It's nice to visit here. If you print 32 photos (passport size), the cost will be low (i.e., 200 rupees only). Different frames are available with reasonable cost. You can book to one day events and functions as well. The timing is morning 9 am to night 9 pm. Overall, it's a good experience.
